spans.s:
f. (-ना)
1 An army.
2 A goddess, the personified armament of the gods, the wife of

The mother of the third Jaina pontiff of the present era.
E.
षि to bind, नक् and टाप् affs., or स with, इन a lord or leader.

n. (-ङ्गं)
A component part or member of an army, as elephants, chariots, cavalry or infantry.
E.
सेना an army, and अङ्ग limb or member.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
A soldier, a camp-follower, &c. one belonging to or who accompanies an army.
E.
सेना an army, चर to go, ट aff.

m. (-नीः)
1 A general, the commander of an army.
2 KĀRTTIKEYA, the military deity of the Hindus.
E.
सेना an army, णी to lead, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-तिः)
1 A general, the commander of an army.
2 KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
सेना an army, and पति master.

n. (-त्वं)
Generalship.
E.
त्व added to the last.

n. (-खं)
1 A division of an army or battalion, a company or three Pattis, consisting of three elephants, three chariots, nine horse, and fifteen foot.
2 A mound or covered way in front of a city gate.
E.
सेना an army, and मुख commencement.

m. (-क्षः)
A guard, a piquet, a centinel, &c.
E.
सेना an army, and रक्ष what protects or guards.
